title: Mission Control vertical slice
description: End-to-end pipeline for the Mission Control dashboard: Ground Control theme → real R3F scene (starfield + satellites) → react-query fetch → gap badges on gap/partial metrics.

requirements.title: Ground Control theme fully populated
requirements.description: ui/src/themes/ground-control.css defines the full electric-blue/monospace/space palette via CSS custom properties.

requirements.title: Real R3F scene (starfield + satellites)
requirements.description: ui/src/scenes/missionControl.tsx renders an instanced-points starfield plus 3-5 rotating satellite node meshes, wired to the Ground Control palette. No metric-bound visuals.

requirements.title: Live data fetch + gap badges
requirements.description: MissionControl page fetches /api/v1/dashboards/mission-control via react-query and renders GapBadge on gap/partial metrics.
